guard: FrameReader refuses a client-claimed length above MAX_FRAME_SIZE and refuses undrained bytes above MAX_BUFFER_SIZE, before hello and before the body arrives
why: An unauthenticated local peer can send a 4-byte header claiming hundreds of megabytes. Without the per-frame cap the custodian waits for that body; without the total-buffer cap many small frames still grow RSS. Both cells import src through tsx and the live custodian loads dist, so the command builds first and afterRestore rebuilds.

mutations.name: M1 drop the per-frame size rejection
mutations.expectRed: a claimed 500MB frame is refused before the body arrives
mutations.cell: a claimed 500MB frame is refused before the body arrives

mutations.name: M2 drop the total-buffer bound
mutations.expectRed: undrained bytes cannot grow past the total buffer bound
mutations.cell: undrained bytes cannot grow past the total buffer bound
